GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground late # ran on from last
Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 4th 1x1 2 Lengths enjoyed good trail Joined in 3 Wide of 4 Turning for home Beaten off @ 400m Effort Short Lived ! had its chance - # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped. Rdr reported his mnt over-raced in the early and middle stages and refused to settle and, as a result, was left without a finishing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased to last 11l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported he assessed the early pace to be quite fast and, as a result, elected to allow the mare to settle into a comfortable rhythm. He added that his mnt was able to make ground steadily on the field until near the 600m, however, when placed under pressure, ran home only fairly and was disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat clear 2nd 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up half off, same 200m, 1 length off 100m, kept on well late # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated he was asked to ride the mare in a forward position but not necessarily to lead. He said after sharing the lead at a comfortable tempo in the early stages, it took him some distance after the 1500m to steady his mount to allow that runner to cross which resulted in both horses establishing a margin on the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths out 3 Wide x 600m, Under Pressure Turning for home Weakened to the line - # struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Took sit 3rd Inside 3 Lengths enjoyed good trail Ridden Along x 600m Couldn'T Go On Turning for home had # all favours, poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped. Rdr reported the mare did not appreciate the Heavy track conditions and, as a result, finished tailed off. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat back 9l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, half off 100m, took over 50m and drew clear # all honours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively; settled back. From its barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Collared x Turn and run ended 300 - # lame 1/5
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 0.5kg over allotted weight. When qst re leading, rdr std instructed to obtain cover, however mnt raced keenly in early stages & as a result was unable to obtain cover so he allowed it to roll forward to obtain lead passing winning post on first occasion. Added mnt continued to race keenly in lead through mid stages & was left without a finishing effort, & he suggests the addition of a crossover noseband. A post-race vet exam revealed mare to be lame (1/5) in off foreleg. Tnr rep was told a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well without threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled off pace. Raced keenly through the early stages. Near the 1300m, whilst continuing to race keenly, had to be steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled near last 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up half off all clear, took over approaching 100m and drew clear # bit on these
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after jumping shifted out and bumped the hindquarter of another rnr. Near the 300m was momentarily unable to be tested when awkwardly placed on the heels of another rnr

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat 4-5l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, hit line well just no match leader/winner # back/ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and made contact. Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1100m shifted out and made contact. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.
